name: macbook_m2
_note: UNCALIBRATED PRIOR built from public specifications and assumptions, not from measurements on this machine. Run `python -m benchmarks.profile_hardware --template <this profile>` and `python -m benchmarks.run_llama_bench` on the machine to replace it. Unified memory is modelled as a CPU device and a GPU device that share one memory system through a link with no latency and effectively unlimited bandwidth. Values assume the base M2 chip with 16 GB; edit for M2 Pro or M2 Max.
